name: visiting-hours-lena-round2
title: Visiting Hours: Lena, round 2
subtitle: Lena redone from your notes (2026-10-10), on Nano Banana Pro (it's back), 0 credits: a round, soft face unlike Nadia's narrow angular one; a ceramicist's dusty-rose long-sleeved dress under a clay-smeared apron; SLEEVES DOWN in every view; the pencil resting on top of her ear with her hair tucked behind it. Green = my pick, blue = the alternate.
questions: Side by side with Nadia (top): do they now read as two unrelated women at a glance?
Is the ceramicist look right (dress, apron, boots, clay on her hands), or should she lean more 'artist' than 'potter'?
Does the pencil on her ear read as deliberate now? (Clearest in the side view and the dream art; in the front view her hair covers the ear.)
Are the dream billboard and faces cute enough, and not too wrong?
notes: Judged against your five points: every take has the sleeves down to the wrists (none rejected for that). The round face, wide-set green eyes and button nose are the named contrasts to Nadia's narrow face; I did not attach Nadia's sheet when making Lena.
The waking turnaround used Mags's sheet as the style and layout reference only (a clearly different woman), so nothing of Nadia's or the old Lena's face carried over.
Weak spot: in the waking front view the pencil sits behind the ear but the hair hides the ear itself, so it reads less clearly than in the side view.
For the dream expressions I picked the take whose dot eyes match the billboard; the alternate has bigger irises (cuter, but off-model with the billboard).
